h: Omo-Agege warns that anyone rigging the 2027 elections risks their life
p: Former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege has reportedly warned that people planning to rig the 2027 elections are putting their lives at risk. The remark comes as parties step up campaigning and the voters' register row continues.
more: The warning drew quick reactions online.
INEC has so far insisted the process will be credible.
